easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
description:
Play Rith's Grove.
When Rith's Grove enters, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Rith's Grove.
Resolve the Rith's Grove trigger from step 2, causing you to sacrifice it
Haru triggers, returning Rith's Grove from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
